text.Was ist das Local Hero Kit?: What is the Local Hero Kit?
text.Ein Paket für kleine Unternehmen vor Ort: A package for small local businesses: your own website, a properly set-up Google Business Profile and the technical basis for AI searches to find you. Built once, paid once.
text.Was kostet eine Website für ein kleines: What does a website for a small business cost?
text.Das Local Hero Kit kostet einmalig 1.150: The Local Hero Kit costs €1,150 one-off, as an offer until 1 March 2027, then €1,500. The only running costs are domain and email, from €2 a month. You pay those directly to the provider.
text.Was ist der Unterschied zu einem Website: How is it different from a website builder?
text.Die Seiten liegen fertig auf dem Server,: The pages sit ready on the server instead of being assembled on every visit. That makes them fast and robust. There is no system in the background that you have to maintain or update.
text.Was ist eine Domain, und brauche ich ein: What is a domain, and do I need one?
text.Die Domain ist die Adresse deiner Websit: The domain is the address of your website, for example yourbusiness.com. Yes, you need one. It is registered in your name, and you pay the provider directly.

text.Ja. Sie wird zuerst für das Handy gestal: Yes. It is designed for phones first and then extended to larger screens, because most visitors of local businesses come by phone.
text.Wenn du das brauchst, ja. Ein Buchungska: If you need that, yes. A booking calendar or your opening hours are built in as needed. A contact form is always included.
text.Was ist ein Google-Unternehmensprofil, u: What is a Google Business Profile, and why does it matter?
text.Das ist der Eintrag mit Adresse, Öffnung: It is the listing with address, opening hours, photos and reviews that appears on Google and Google Maps. Many people see it before they visit your website. In the kit it is set up and handed over in good shape.
text.Werde ich damit bei Google gefunden?: Will I be found on Google with it?
text.Die Seite bekommt alles, was Google zum: The site gets everything Google needs to classify it: clean technology, structured data and clear content. Nobody can honestly promise a specific position in the search results. Neither can I.
